subject: Rstudio incorrectly checks xpath and returns an error when publishing.

messages.author: a79bb39e464c0da0
messages.subject: Rstudio incorrectly checks xpath and returns an error when publishing.
parts:
Hi all,

Rstudio sensibly tries to flag apps that won't work once published based on the location of local data. However, the checker is a bit overzealous and mistakes parsing of xml as the user trying to read in data. For example

I am interacting with a web API. I then need to do some parsing of the xml. 

 r<-wcPOST()
  start_epoch <- as.numeric(now() - lubridate::days(days_lag))
  
  #Get program number
  xpath <- paste("//data/deployment/argos/last_uplink_date", 
                 "[number() > number(", start_epoch, ")]/../program_number", sep = "")
  program_number <- XML::xpathSApply(XML::xmlParse(content(r,"text")), xpath, XML::xmlValue)
 
This all works great locally. Note there is no interaction with the local file system. But when I go to publish I get. "Paths should be to files within the project directory".


Is this the correct place to report this error? It is currently limiting me from publishing.

Thank you.
